summary_en: CYND Co., Ltd. declared its first dividend of 15 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027, consisting entirely of a 15 yen commemorative dividend marking the company's 15th anniversary and fifth anniversary of listing. The company has not paid dividends previously, prioritizing business expansion and retained earnings.
title_en: Notice regarding modification of dividend forecast (15th anniversary commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief:
CYND Co., Ltd. announced on November 13, 2026, its first dividend payment following a board resolution. The company will pay 15 yen per share as a commemorative dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. This consists entirely of a special commemorative distribution and includes no regular dividend component.

The company has not distributed dividends since its inception, prioritizing business expansion and strengthening retained earnings. The timing of this initial dividend marks two milestones: the company's 15th anniversary in October 2026 and its fifth anniversary since listing in December 2021. The company operates primarily as a reservation management system provider for beauty and barber salons, with its main services BeautyMerit and Kanzashi having surpassed 25,000 contracted salon locations across the group.

The company indicated in the disclosure that it will consider continuous profit returns to shareholders from the next fiscal year (year ending March 2028) onwards, taking comprehensive account of earnings trends and financial conditions.
